items.name: Behind Story
items.summary: After Johann endures a brutal murder-suicide attempt by his own division teacher, a scandal involving his school escalates into a nationwide uproar. To Taehee's distress, Johann vanishes for three years. Both boys mature into men, leading separate lives. Taehee finds work at a nightclub alongside the charming bartender Jungin. In contrast, the isolated Johann remains under the radar. One day, Taehee and Johann catch sight of one another. But Taehee's envious friend Dooyong is determined to keep the two men apart.

items.name: Behind the Stage
items.summary: Jin-woo, a hardworking model student, makes the decision to go clubbing for the very first time. Under the influence of alcohol, Jin-woo ends up having an impulsive one-night stand with the first attractive man he meets, only to find himself alone in an empty room the following morning. On the bedside table are several 50,000 won bills. Perplexed, Jin-woo presumes he has been paid for s** and is filled with anger, but chooses to push the incident to the back of his mind. After he returns to university, Jin-woo assists his juniors with their performance and locks eyes with a familiar figure on stage. It's the man from that night whom he believed he would never encounter again, Kwon Tae-young. Then, in front of everyone, Tae-young exclaims with a glint in his eye: "Found you."

items.summary: The story revolves around three boys and their challenging encounters with love.

items.name: Behind the Scenes
items.summary: In an extravagant annual production covertly financed by the mafia, the once-prominent actor Lu Huaming finds himself unexpectedly chosen for the role of the second male lead, sharing the screen with the immensely popular actor, Lu Zuo. However, delays in filming test the patience of everyone involved, particularly Long Xiaoyue—the project’s supervisor and the son of the mafia boss. Frustrated with Huaming’s unimpressive acting skills, Long Xiaoyue quickly grows antagonistic towards him. Nevertheless, as their exchanges become more frequent, Long Xiaoyue starts to sense that Huaming is burdened by a hidden and painful past.

items.name: Behind the Lens
items.summary: In New York, private investigator Noah Yoon is drawn into turmoil during his investigation of a fraud case at WPC when he encounters the charming CEO Egon Wagner. At the same time, Meanwhile Mason, his best friend since childhood who harbors secret feelings for Noah, recognizes the threat and resolves to compete for Noah's affection.

items.name: Behind The Gifs
items.summary: During their adventurous journey through the dusty catacombs of a Pharaoh's tomb, fearless explorers AC Stuart and Kat Swenski stumbled upon an ancient artifact that granted them the ability to uncover the narratives behind any animated GIF. In another event, they were bitten by a radioactive cartoonist. Together, they harness their unique powers to delve into the reality Behind the GIF.

items.name: Behind the Scandal
items.summary: Chan’s always been the one to blend in, unlike his friend Dowoon the celebrity. From the States, Dowoon’s always gotten attention wherever he goes for his height and his looks. It’s really no surprise Chan fell for him at first sight… but he’s been keeping his feelings a secret since high school. But then one day, just like that, Dowoon asks Chan to be his boyfriend. Bewildered, Chan tries to laugh it off as a joke but he can’t seem to stop thinking about it. Then on the very same day, Chan comes across an article saying Dowoon is romantically involved with some other woman. Was Dowoon being serious about what he said, or was he simply playing a mean prank? Just what could his mixed signals mean? What’s going on behind the scandal?

items.summary: Jin Hyuk, who has spent his life depending on wealthy women, finds himself imprisoned for three years following a conviction for fraud and theft. As he adjusts to his new reality behind bars, he risks becoming someone's prison bitch due to his attractive looks. Seok Jun, infamous for being incarcerated for murder, comes to his aid in a tough spot. From that moment on, Jin Hyuk resolves to stay close to him for protection... which turns out to be a significant mistake.

But still, Taesung can't help but be pulled in by Sunny's irresistible charm..

items.alt_name: The Truth Behind the Sadistic Prince
items.summary: Natalia, the daughter of a Count, cannot stand the idea of marriage. This aversion stems from her ability to perceive people's emotions as colors in their aura. While her maids appear to smile, they radiate red with animosity, and her kind instructors are tinged with the hue of anger. This inability to trust leads Natalia to ruin her debutante ball, ultimately retreating into seclusion. Concerned for her wellbeing, her younger brother Julian takes her to a ball thrown by a member of the royal family. However, the overwhelming combination of colors and auras makes Natalia feel nauseous. Suddenly, she notices an aura filled with red anger and black hatred! It's the most intense aura she has ever encountered, completely hiding the individual responsible. Natalia stands frozen, shaking as the figure comes closer. To her shock, she realizes it is His Highness Prince Ludwig...?!

items.summary: Rosa aspires to don armor and become a valiant knight! However, she must begin her journey as a squire first. The responsibilities at the castle are far from glamorous. One minute she is tending to the horses in the stable, and the next she is tackling the chore of chopping firewood or overcoming a pile of laundry. She must always be prepared to help the knight she is assigned to! Although her position may appear minor and the chores routine, each task is a crucial step on her path to knighthood. Rosa is determined to confront every obstacle with the spirit of a hero!

items.alt_name: If You Remove the Kind Protagonist's Mask
items.summary: As the number one stalker of Pope Ulysses, the kind-hearted male lead, Yoidel was sentenced to death for her offenses. Just moments before her execution, Yoidel manages to escape her cell to seek assistance from Ulysses, only to encounter a bloodthirsty madman... who surprisingly is the male lead himself! In a frantic effort to survive, Yoidel forges a magical contract with him, binding their fates together and condemning them to share both their lives and their deaths. Now entangled with a duplicitous psycho, will Yoidel discover a way to sever their connection before it leads to her own destruction?
